column5: GROUP: **legalized-operations (5)** | 113. `LO/identity/calling.rs:393-397` five boundary realization payloads are encoded as a bare tag.
GROUP: **legalized-operations (5)** | 114. `LO/validation.rs:226` a `TargetFamily` origin is accepted for any non-empty `target` string.

GROUP: **target-operations (2)** | 115. `TO/descriptor_input.rs:35-48, 73-87, 110, 136-145` `Ok(None)` means no guard. Wrong program: "a descriptor-reading call whose declaration/argument shape is not the exact 3-parameter form returns no guard, so no byte limit is attached".
GROUP: **target-operations (2)** | 116. `TO/values.rs:185-189` `projected_family` leaves origins with a non-`Projected` extent unextended.

GROUP: **optimization-core (1)** | 117. `F/optimization-core/src/optimization_core/decisions/baseline.rs:162-178` decode accepts a self-consistent log whose Choose is outside its roster or whose roster is not in canonical order. Traced within the file; whether pipeline 01 re-checks is open.
GROUP: **bounded-process (1)** | 118. `F/bounded-process/src/process_child.rs:251` on non-Unix, `ErrorKind::InvalidInput` from termination is treated as "container already closed".

GROUP: **terminal-runtime (2)** | 119. `I/terminal-runtime/src/execution.rs:103-115` `comparison_unavailable` marks a run unavailable instead of failed for `MissingProvision` and four interpreter error kinds; how the CLI treats it was not read.

GROUP: **terminal-runtime (2)** | 120. `I/terminal-runtime/src/execution/host_imports/allocation.rs:360` the `memset` handler's liveness test does not exclude retired allocations, so a freed address passes the handler check (partly traced: later resolution errors at `allocation/backing.rs:54`).
